title: Lead - Salesforce Development & Architecture
description:
**About The Role**
We’re seeking a strategic and highly experienced
**Lead—Salesforce Development and Architecture**
to drive platform excellence across our Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and extended Salesforce ecosystem. This role will serve as a technical leader and mentor, managing a team of developers and administrators while architecting scalable solutions that align with cross-functional business priorities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect end-to-end solutions leveraging LWC, APEX, CPQ, Flow, and custom integrations
* Design scalable systems across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and other cloud products including Experience, Marketing, and Revenue Cloud
* Lead and mentor developers and administrators, fostering a culture of innovation, ownership, and technical excellence
* Establish and enforce coding standards, release management practices, and governance protocols
* Collaborate with RevOps, Sales, Support, Orders, Billing and Marketing stakeholders to translate business needs into robust technical designs
* Own documentation standards for architecture, data models, and system integrations
* Oversee DevOps processes for deployment automation, sandbox management, and version control
* Ensure system compliance, data integrity, and process automation across key workflows
* Manage third-party integrations with tools such as HubSpot, ZoomInfo, Zuora, and Zapier

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 8 years hands-on experience in Salesforce development and administration
* Expertise in:
* Lightning Web Components (LWC)
* Apex Classes & Triggers
* CPQ (Configuration, Pricing, and Quoting)
* Flow Builder & Process Automation
* Data modeling, role hierarchies, and permission sets
* Proven experience leading Salesforce technical teams and mentoring junior developers/admins
* Deep knowledge of Salesforce best practices, limits, and optimization techniques
* Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns (REST, SOAP, middleware)
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence across technical and business audiences

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Salesforce Architect certifications (Application Architect, System Architect)
* Certified Salesforce CPQ Specialist or equivalent
* Experience implementing Salesforce DevOps Center, Git, CI/CD pipelines
* Strategic exposure to revenue operations, marketing automation, and compliance dashboards

**What We Offer**

* High-impact role with leadership visibility
* Collaborative, cross-functional environment
* Opportunity to define the architectural future of Salesforce within a growing organization
